% Blank lines inside the braces of algorithm2e's blocks, as in the PDF:
% each line of a block is a paragraph of the block's div, numbered as in
% the PDF, and a blank line adds no empty paragraph. The blocks are those
% of every style (vlined, lined, without lines, and \SetNothing), with the
% ends of noend, ShortEnd, and LongEnd, and of every keyword family, in
% the algorithm, algorithm*, procedure, and function environments, with
% procnumbered. A blank line may come first or last in a block, follow a
% line without \;, or come twice, and a \label after one is the target
% of its \ref. A blank line between lines outside any block was already
% right, and is checked so it stays right.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[vlined,linesnumbered,procnumbered]{algorithm2e}
\SetKwProg{Fn}{Function}{ is}{end}
\SetKwBlock{Begin}{begin}{end}
\begin{document}
Line~\ref{line:bthree} of Algorithm~\ref{alg:vlined} follows a blank line.

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{Vlined blocks}\label{alg:vlined}
\If{case A}{
  line aone\;

  line atwo\;
}
\For{case B}{

  line bone\;
  \If{case B inner}{
    line btwo without a semicolon

    line bthree\label{line:bthree}\;

  }

}
\eIf{case C}{
  line cone\;

  line ctwo\;
}{
  line cthree\;

  line cfour\;
}
\uIf{case U}{
  line uone\;

  line utwo\;
}
\ElseIf{case U else if}{
  line uthree\;

  line ufour\;
}
\Else{
  line ufive\;

  line usix\;
}
\While{case W}{
  line wone\;


  line wtwo\;\par
  \tcp{a comment after a blank line}

  line wthree\;
}
\end{algorithm}

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\SetAlgoLined
\caption{Lined blocks}
\While{case lined}{
  line lone\;

  line ltwo\;
}
\SetAlgoLongEnd
\For{case long}{
  line gone\;

  line gtwo\;
}
\end{algorithm}

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\SetAlgoNoLine
\caption{Blocks without lines}
\Fn{case D}{
  line done\;

  \Repeat{case D until}{
    line dtwo\;

    line dthree\;
  }
}
\end{algorithm}

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{A blank line outside the blocks}
line eone\;

line etwo\;
\end{algorithm}

\begin{procedure}[H]
\SetAlgoNoEnd
\caption{proc()}
\Switch{case F}{
  \Case{case F one}{
    line fone\;

    line ftwo\;
  }
  \uIf{case F if}{
    line fthree\;

    line ffour\;
  }
  \Else{
    line ffive\;

    line fsix\;
  }
  \Other{
    line fseven\;

    line feight\;
  }
}
\end{procedure}

\begin{function}[H]
\SetNothing
\caption{func()}
\Begin{
  line hone\;

  line htwo\;
}
\end{function}

\begin{algorithm*}
\SetAlgoShortEnd
\SetAlgoLined
\caption{A wide algorithm}
\ForEach{case H}{
  line kone\;

  \lIf{case H one-line}{line ktwo}

  line kthree\;
}
\end{algorithm*}
\end{document}
